# Digitalmenue.com   Digital Menu Platform for Pakistan

> Digitalmenue.com is Pakistan's leading QR-based digital menu and WhatsApp ordering platform for restaurants, cafes, and food businesses.

## About

- Founded: 2024
- Location: Faisalabad, Pakistan
- Pricing: Free Trial (PKR 0/7 days), Starter (PKR 1,200/mo), Growth (PKR 2,500/mo), Premium (PKR 4,500/mo)
- No commission on orders

## Features

- QR code generation for restaurant menus
- WhatsApp order integration with automatic message formatting
- Real-time menu updates (pricing, photos, availability)
- Analytics dashboard with order tracking
- Urdu language support
- JazzCash, Easypaisa, and bank transfer payments
